description: Registered suppressions. Every live suppression directive (oxlint, eslint, ts-expect-error, ts-ignore, ts-nocheck) must match an entry by file and directive, and every entry needs a live suppression. An entry names its scope, reason, native alternatives examined, owner, versions and retirement trigger.

exceptions.reason: kokoro-js (from_pretrained, generate) and the dynamic import that keeps onnxruntime-node unloaded on a cache hit return Promises. Passing such a thunk to Effect.tryPromise makes typescript/promise-function-async demand an async arrow (its autofix adds it), which effecttsgo/async-function then flags: the two rules contradict each other for every Promise thunk. The file is the speech package's only Promise boundary.
nativeAlternativesExamined: Effect.tryPromise with a non-async thunk: rejected by typescript/promise-function-async (the fixer rewrites it to async)
Effect.promise and Effect.callback: the same Promise-returning thunk, so the same conflict
Stream.fromAsyncIterable over KokoroTTS.stream: streams sentence chunks, no cancellation, and would still need the dynamic import and from_pretrained Promises
a child process running kokoro: no CLI ships with kokoro-js, and the 311 MiB model would load once per Line
exceptions.retirementTrigger: effecttsgo/async-function stops flagging thunks passed to Effect.tryPromise, or kokoro-js is replaced by an Effect-native text-to-speech client
